ideas.description: Exploit, a time-free margin source and the pre-registered follow-up to E054. On the E059 tip (2/2/3 net, 2x20+3x24+3x28+2.5x32 px, head scale 2x, ls 0.4, BN-bias lr multiplier 32x; official 0.7565, dev 0.7557 @ 5.25 s), halve the BN-bias lr multiplier again, from 32x to 16x, and change nothing else. Muon lr/momentum, head lr, SGD-group wd and momentum, schedule, Lookahead, resolutions, freezing and the bias window all stay fixed. If the multiplier is folded into the GPU schedule tensor, nothing needs recapturing; otherwise recapture all graphs in build. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12 and compare against E059's own dev mean (0.7557). Contingency: if dev rises >=0.15 pp, try 8x next; if it falls >=0.15 pp, 32x is near the optimum and the BN-bias axis is closed.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (±0.5%, about 5.25 s). Dev mean between -0.25 and +0.3 pp of 0.7557, with a weak prior of +0.05 to +0.15 pp: 64x to 32x gave +0.27 pp, and the response should flatten. Keep if dev gains >=0.1 pp and official >=0.7535. That margin would pay for the group-3 depth cut.

ideas.description: Exploit, work removal in group 3, extending E059's finding that one 8x8 group-2 conv cost ~0.73 s for only -0.15 pp. First microbenchmark ms/step per phase on the current recipe (graphed, Muon included) for group 3 at 3 vs 2 convs. If the 2-conv version saves >=4%, cut group 3 from 3 convs to 2 (net 2/2/2, airbench94-style) at width 576, keeping the pooling position and head. Remove the 576x5184 matrix from the batched-NS shape groups; it is the largest Muon matrix. Hold epochs, resolutions, schedule, ls, head scale, BN-bias multiplier, freezing and the bias window fixed. Recapture all graphs in build. Check that eval returns finite [B,100] logits for B in {1, 7, 513, 1024}. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12. If the microbenchmark saves <3%, log it and do not run. Run this after the BN-bias 16x idea, on whichever base is then the tip.
ideas.expected: Time -0.35 to -0.55 s (-7 to -10%, to about 4.7-4.9 s). The group-3 conv has about half the MACs of the removed group-2 conv, but it runs at low efficiency at 4x4 and also drops the biggest NS matmul. Dev mean -0.15 to -0.5 pp, centred near -0.3 pp, so about 0.6-1.2 s per pp, a better trade than the 32 px tail (0.67 pp/s). Keep if dev >=0.754 and official >=0.7535. If dev lands in 0.752-0.754, bank it as a cut to stack with the next margin source (group-2 width).

ideas.description: Exploit, buying back group-2 capacity after E059's depth cut (depth-for-width). First microbenchmark ms/step per phase for group 2 at 2 convs with width 384 vs 448 (graphed, Muon included). If 448 costs <=+5% ms/step, widen group 2 on the E059 tip from 384 to 448 channels in both of its convs, adjusting the group-3 input conv and the Muon NS shape groups. Hold epochs, resolutions, schedule, ls, head scale, freezing and the bias window fixed. Recapture all graphs in build. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12. If the microbenchmark shows >+6%, log it and do not run.
ideas.expected: Time +2.5-5% (about +0.13-0.26 s, to about 5.4-5.5 s). Dev mean +0.1 to +0.3 pp, centred near +0.15 pp. Not keepable on its own (slower). It wins as a margin source if the gain is >=0.67 pp/s (the tail rate), i.e. about >=0.12 pp per +0.18 s. Then it becomes the base for the group-3 depth cut or a further 32 px tail trim. A gain <0.08 pp closes group-2 width as a margin source.

ideas.description: Explore whether anchor-fixed low-res steps buy margin, rebased onto the 2/2/3 net, where an epoch is now much cheaper. On the E059 tip, add one 20 px epoch at the start (3x20+3x24+3x28+2.5x32). Fix the LR warmup length and the Lookahead alpha ramp in absolute steps at their E059 values; the decay portion absorbs the extra 32 steps. The whitening bias trains through the whole 20 px phase (3 epochs; E029 found 3-5 epochs neutral), so no new graph is needed. Change nothing else. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12. Compare against E036's -0.27 pp, where the anchors moved.
ideas.expected: Time +0.28-0.34 s (a 20 px epoch on the 2/2/3 net), to about 5.55 s. Dev mean +0.1 to +0.35 pp if anchoring caused E036's loss, i.e. >=0.5 pp/s, comparable to the tail. A dev gain >=0.15 pp supports H1.9 and makes cheap anchored low-res epochs the way to repay structural cuts. A gain <0.05 pp supports the plateau reading (H6) and closes epoch-based margin. Discard as a run unless it also beats the tip on time.

ideas.description: Explore a time-free Muon schedule knob (D004 C0029/C0030, cyclical momentum). On the E059 tip, turn the Muon momentum from a graph constant into a per-step GPU schedule tensor that runs opposite to the LR triangle: 0.72 at step 0, falling linearly to 0.60 at peak LR, then rising linearly back to 0.72 at the end (mean ≈ the current 0.655). The Nesterov form, lr, SGD groups, Lookahead, resolutions and everything else stay fixed. Recapture all graphs in build. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (±0.5%). Dev mean -0.2 to +0.25 pp, weak prior +0.05 to +0.1 pp: fixed momentum 0.75 was neutral (E040), but the cyclic form lowers momentum where the steps are largest. Keep if dev gains >=0.1 pp and official >=0.7535. A |delta| <0.1 pp closes the Muon-momentum axis.

structured_output.summary:
I added 5 ideas and dropped none, so the queue now holds 7: the 2 already queued (the I066 train-fit diagnostic and I067's Gram reuse) plus these 5.

**Where things stand.** E059 is the incumbent: official 0.7565, dev 0.7557, at 5.25 s. Its expected margin over the 0.753 bar is only about +0.27 pp on dev seeds, so the next steps need to add margin and keep cutting work.

**Margin (time-free), priority 5.** Halve the BN-bias lr multiplier again, from 32x to 16x. This is the contingency E054 left open: going from 64x to 32x gave +0.27 pp on dev, and the only other margin source found since E030 is the head scale.

**Time cut, priority 4.** Cut group 3 from 3 convs to 2. E059 showed that removing one deep, low-efficiency conv saved about 0.73 s for only -0.15 pp. The group-3 conv also carries the largest Newton-Schulz matrix, so I expect -7 to -10% time for about -0.3 pp. A microbenchmark runs first and decides whether the full run goes ahead.

**Capacity, priority 3.** Widen group 2 from 384 to 448 channels in its 2 convs (H6.1.4). This trades depth for width and buys back accuracy at an exchange rate that can be compared with the 32 px tail's 0.67 pp/s.

**Explore, priority 2.**
- Add one 20 px epoch with the schedule anchors fixed in absolute steps (H1.9.1). This finally tests whether E036's loss came from moved anchors, now that an epoch is cheap.
- Cyclical Muon momentum that runs opposite to the LR triangle (D004 C0029), which costs no time.

Every idea is judged on dev seeds 3-12 against E059's dev mean (0.7557). Keep rules require dev ≥0.754 and official ≥0.7535.
